description: Reference board for the x99-bios-fixes MR9A records.

firmware.title: X9R9A Ver:003 2023-11-10 (alternative build reported on MR9A PRO V1.2 boards)
firmware.note: Not the firmware of the reference board. The owner reports it on MR9A PRO V1.2 units. No public source found on 2026-11-13 names the banner X9R9A, so whether it is an alternative MR9A PRO build or the firmware of another board is not established. It differs from the March build by a "Re-Size BAR Support" Setup option (Setup+0x48), which shifts the later Setup fields by one byte. Analysed offline from one image (SHA-256 078459d5bce27875cdf193ee4ebfdd4deb523a4ea1fcf855e436cbe540739133); never flashed or booted in this investigation.

facts.statement: The board carries a Nuvoton NCT5532D Super I/O (read the chip marking). The H01/H02 analysis uses that chip's datasheet.
